#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build an Annual Financial Report PDF with a cover page (pure-Python PDF writer + pypdf merge)."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader

W, H = 612, 792  # US Letter

# Helvetica AFM widths (1/1000 em) for approximate centering
WIDTHS = {
    32:278,33:278,34:355,35:556,36:556,37:889,38:667,39:191,40:333,41:333,
    42:389,43:584,44:278,45:333,46:278,47:278,48:556,49:556,50:556,51:556,
    52:556,53:556,54:556,55:556,56:556,57:556,58:278,59:278,60:584,61:584,
    62:584,63:556,64:1015,65:667,66:667,67:722,68:722,69:667,70:611,71:778,
    72:722,73:278,74:500,75:667,76:556,77:833,78:722,79:778,80:667,81:778,
    82:722,83:667,84:611,85:722,86:667,87:944,88:667,89:667,90:611,91:278,
    92:278,93:278,94:469,95:556,96:333,97:556,98:556,99:500,100:556,101:556,
    102:278,103:556,104:556,105:222,106:222,107:500,108:222,109:833,110:556,
    111:556,112:556,113:556,114:333,115:500,116:278,117:556,118:500,119:722,
    120:500,121:500,122:500,123:334,124:260,125:334,126:584,
}

def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(WIDTHS.get(ord(c), 556) for c in s) * size / 1000.0

def wrap(text, size, max_w):
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for word in text.split():
        trial = (cur + " " + word).strip()
        if text_width(trial, size) <= max_w:
            cur = trial
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def make_pdf(path, pages):
    """Write a minimal PDF. 1 Catalog, 2 Pages, 3 Helvetica, 4 Helvetica-Bold,
    5..5+n-1 Page objs, 5+n..5+2n-1 content streams."""
    n = len(pages)
    objs = []
    objs.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    kids = " ".join(f"{5+i} 0 R" for i in range(n))
    objs.append(f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {n} >>".encode())
    objs.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    objs.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>")
    for i in range(n):
        objs.append(f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {W} {H}] "
                    f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R >> >> "
                    f"/Contents {5+n+i} 0 R >>".encode())
    for ops in pages:
        stream = ops.encode("latin-1")
        objs.append(b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
                    + stream + b"\nendstream")
    data = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = [0] * (len(objs) + 1)
    for i, obj in enumerate(objs, start=1):
        offsets[i] = len(data)
        data += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode() + obj + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(data)
    data += f"xref\n0 {len(objs)+1}\n".encode() + b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, len(objs) + 1):
        data += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    data += (f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
             f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n").encode()
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)

def build_cover(date_long):
    ops = []
    ops.append("0.09 0.17 0.38 rg 0 712 612 80 re f")   # top band
    ops.append("0.09 0.17 0.38 rg 0 0 612 10 re f")     # bottom band
    ops.append("0.83 0.62 0.22 RG 3 w 60 700 m 552 700 l S")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    tw = text_width(title, 30)
    ops.append(f"BT /F2 30 Tf 1 1 1 rg {(W-tw)/2:.1f} 738 Td ({esc(title)}) Tj ET")
    sub = "Fiscal Year 2026"
    tw = text_width(sub, 14)
    ops.append(f"BT /F1 14 Tf 0.85 0.9 1 rg {(W-tw)/2:.1f} 708 Td ({esc(sub)}) Tj ET")
    y = 430
    for text, size in [("Prepared by the Finance Department", 14),
                       ("Consolidated Statements and Analysis", 12),
                       (f"Date: {date_long}", 16)]:
        tw = text_width(text, size)
        color = "0.15 0.2 0.3 rg" if size != 16 else "0.09 0.17 0.38 rg"
        ops.append(f"BT /F1 {size} Tf {color} {(W-tw)/2:.1f} {y} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET")
        y -= 30
    ops.append(f"BT /F1 8 Tf 0.5 0.5 0.5 rg 56 30 Td ({esc('Confidential - For internal distribution only')}) Tj ET")
    return "\n".join(ops)

def heading(ops, text, y):
    ops.append(f"BT /F2 17 Tf 0.09 0.17 0.38 rg 56 {y} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET")
    ops.append(f"0.83 0.62 0.22 RG 1.5 w 56 {y-6} m 220 {y-6} l S")
    return y - 24

def paragraph(ops, text, y, size=11, leading=15, x=56, max_w=500):
    for line in wrap(text, size, max_w):
        if y < 50:
            return y
        ops.append(f"BT /F1 {size} Tf 0.15 0.2 0.3 rg {x} {y} Td ({esc(line)}) Tj ET")
        y -= leading
    return y - 6

def build_body(date_long):
    pages = []
    # Page 1: Executive Summary
    ops = []
    y = 740
    ops.append(f"BT /F2 22 Tf 0.09 0.17 0.38 rg 56 {y} Td (Annual Financial Report) Tj ET")
    y -= 26
    ops.append(f"BT /F1 11 Tf 0.4 0.4 0.4 rg 56 {y} Td ({esc(date_long)}) Tj ET")
    y -= 34
    y = heading(ops, "1. Executive Summary", y)
    y = paragraph(ops, ("The company closed fiscal year 2026 with record operating results. "
        "Total revenue grew 14.2% year over year to $48.6 million, driven by strong "
        "performance across all business segments and the successful launch of two new "
        "product lines in the second half of the year. Operating expenses increased at "
        "a slower pace, improving the operating margin to 18.4%."), y)
    paragraph(ops, ("Net income for the year reached $6.9 million, up 21.4% from the prior "
        "year, while adjusted EBITDA rose to $11.3 million. The balance sheet remains "
        "strong with $24.1 million in cash and total debt of $8.2 million, a net cash "
        "position that positions the company well for continued investment in growth "
        "initiatives during fiscal 2027."), y)
    pages.append("\n".join(ops))

    # Page 2: Financial Highlights
    ops = []
    y = 740
    y = heading(ops, "2. Financial Highlights", y)
    ops.append(f"BT /F1 10 Tf 0.35 0.35 0.35 rg 56 {y} Td (USD thousands, except per-share data) Tj ET")
    y -= 26
    table = [("Item","FY2024","FY2025","FY2026"),
             ("Revenue","31,208","42,554","48,613"),
             ("Operating Expenses","26,410","35,112","39,672"),
             ("Operating Income","4,798","7,442","8,941"),
             ("Net Income","3,911","5,682","6,902"),
             ("Adjusted EBITDA","7,204","9,618","11,310")]
    cols = [56, 250, 370, 490]
    row_h = 26
    top = y
    ops.append(f"0.09 0.17 0.38 rg 56 {top-26} 500 26 re f")
    for j, c in enumerate(cols):
        text = table[0][j]
        if j == 0:
            ops.append(f"BT /F2 10 Tf 1 1 1 rg {c+6} {top-19} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET")
        else:
            tw = text_width(text, 10)
            ops.append(f"BT /F2 10 Tf 1 1 1 rg {c+(94-tw)/2:.1f} {top-19} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET")
    ry = top - 26
    for r in table[1:]:
        ry -= row_h
        if ry < 50:
            break
        for j, c in enumerate(cols):
            text = r[j]
            if j == 0:
                ops.append(f"BT /F1 10 Tf 0.15 0.2 0.3 rg {c+6} {ry+8} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET")
            else:
                tw = text_width(text, 10)
                ops.append(f"BT /F1 10 Tf 0.15 0.2 0.3 rg {c+(94-tw)/2:.1f} {ry+8} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET")
        ops.append(f"0.8 0.82 0.85 RG 0.75 w 56 {ry} m 556 {ry} l S")
    ops.append(f"0.8 0.82 0.85 RG 0.75 w 56 {top-26} m 56 {ry} l S")
    ops.append(f"0.8 0.82 0.85 RG 0.75 w 556 {top-26} m 556 {ry} l S")
    ops.append(f"0.8 0.82 0.85 RG 0.75 w 56 {top-26} m 556 {top-26} l S")
    ry -= 20
    paragraph(ops, ("Figures are unaudited and presented in accordance with US GAAP. "
        "FY2026 figures reflect the twelve months ended June 30, 2026."), ry, size=9, leading=12)
    pages.append("\n".join(ops))

    # Page 3: Balance Sheet Summary + Outlook
    ops = []
    y = 740
    y = heading(ops, "3. Balance Sheet Summary", y)
    bs = [("Total Assets","42,310"),("Total Liabilities","18,180"),
          ("Total Equity","24,130"),("Cash and Equivalents","24,120"),
          ("Total Debt","8,200")]
    y -= 8
    ops.append(f"0.09 0.17 0.38 rg 56 {y-26} 500 26 re f")
    ops.append(f"BT /F2 10 Tf 1 1 1 rg 62 {y-19} Td (Balance Sheet Line Item) Tj ET")
    tw = text_width("USD thousands", 10)
    ops.append(f"BT /F2 10 Tf 1 1 1 rg {556-tw-6:.1f} {y-19} Td (USD thousands) Tj ET")
    ry = y - 26
    for name, val in bs:
        ry -= 24
        ops.append(f"BT /F1 10 Tf 0.15 0.2 0.3 rg 62 {ry+8} Td ({esc(name)}) Tj ET")
        tw = text_width(val, 10)
        ops.append(f"BT /F1 10 Tf 0.15 0.2 0.3 rg {556-tw-6:.1f} {ry+8} Td ({esc(val)}) Tj ET")
        ops.append(f"0.8 0.82 0.85 RG 0.75 w 56 {ry} m 556 {ry} l S")
    ry -= 20
    y = heading(ops, "4. Outlook for Fiscal 2027", ry - 10)
    paragraph(ops, ("Management expects revenue growth of 10-12% in fiscal 2027, supported "
        "by continued demand in the core markets, international expansion, and the ramp-up "
        "of the new product portfolio. Capital expenditures are planned at $4.5 million, "
        "focused on production capacity and digital infrastructure. The company reiterates "
        "its commitment to disciplined cost management and sustainable, profitable growth."), y)
    pages.append("\n".join(ops))
    return pages

def main():
    today = datetime.date(2026, 8, 1)  # current sandbox date
    date_long = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    make_pdf("cover.pdf", [build_cover(date_long)])
    make_pdf("body.pdf", build_body(date_long))

    writer = PdfWriter()
    for src in ("cover.pdf", "body.pdf"):
        reader = PdfReader(src)
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)

    city = "Unknown City"  # location API unreachable in this sandbox
    writer.add_metadata({
        "/Title": "Annual Financial Report",
        "/Author": "Finance Department",
        "/Subject": f"Annual Financial Report ({city})",
        "/Keywords": "annual, financial, report, cover",
        "/CreationDate": today.strftime("D:%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),
    })
    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    print("Created cover.pdf, body.pdf, report.pdf | Date:", date_long, "| City:", city)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
